description: F309 A8 auto-switch seed — AAPL 5m Alpaca 2023-01-01→2025-06-01 (~47K bars). Seeds strategylab-settings so the app loads this config on startup without UI interaction. Seeds a narrow sessionStorage chart range (last ~1000 bars visible) so fitContent is skipped and the initial view shows < 8000 bars, preventing premature auto-switch on load. The probe then calls setVisibleLogicalRange(0, 30000) to manually trigger the switch. Backend cache must have this data pre-warmed (run: curl http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/ohlcv/AAPL?interval=5m&start=2023-01-01&end=2025-06-01&source=alpaca).
